title: Circuit satisfiability promise problem
statement: For a canonical binary encoding of Boolean circuits, define a binary promise problem whose yes-instances are exactly the strings encoding satisfiable circuits and whose no-instances are exactly the strings that decode to an unsatisfiable circuit. Strings that do not decode as circuits belong to neither set.
hypotheses_covered: A canonical binary encoding of encoded Boolean circuits
